proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4159 *girati drips/falls explicitly gives Nepali girnu, Maithili girab, Bhojpuri giral and Hindi girnā. Kathoriya gir and Kochila Tharu girale elicited come down match this falling/descending family; the latter retains its finite ending. The directional gloss is compatible with fall, but does not establish whether descent was voluntary. Local Indo-Aryan transmission is unresolved. Exact response: gir.
